com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Class AIConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.AIConfig
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    AIAgentConfig, AICompletionConfig, AIJudgeConfig

    public abstract class AIConfig
extends java.lang.Object
    The common, mode-independent surface of a retrieved AI Config.

    Instances are produced by an LDAIClient retrieval method and are always one of the concrete subtypes AICompletionConfig, AIAgentConfig, or AIJudgeConfig. They are immutable and safe to share across threads.

    Application code does not construct these directly; supply defaults via the corresponding *Default types instead.

      • isEnabled

        public boolean isEnabled()
        Returns whether the retrieved configuration is enabled.

        When false, application code should fall back to its own behavior rather than calling a model provider; the other fields may be absent.

        Returns:
        true if the configuration is enabled

      • createTracker

        public LDAIConfigTracker createTracker()
        Creates a new tracker for a single AI run.

        Each invocation is intended to create a fresh tracker for one run, so metrics from distinct runs are not conflated. Call this once per AI run.

        In this release the returned tracker is an internal no-op; metric reporting is implemented in a later step of the AI SDK.

        Returns:
        a tracker for this configuration, never null

      • getEvaluator

        public Evaluator getEvaluator()
        Returns the evaluator that coordinates judge execution for this configuration.

        For AIJudgeConfig this is always Evaluator.noop(). For AICompletionConfig and AIAgentConfig it is the evaluator supplied at construction time (also Evaluator.noop() unless a custom one is wired in).

        Returns:
        the evaluator, never null
